page: Vultr vcg-b200-248c-2826g-1536vram is a Dedicated Metal GPU server designed for extreme computational workloads. The system features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel processor with 248 dedicated vCPUs. It is equipped with 2826.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 11.4 GB of RAM per core to support massive data ingestion and high-throughput processing.

The primary accelerator subsystem consists of eight NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 1536 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. For local data storage, the server includes 13312 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, enabling rapid read and write operations directly on the physical machine. Additionally, the configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the integration of eight enterprise-grade Blackwell GPUs, a high-density memory array, and substantial local NVMe storage, this bare-metal server represents a highly consolidated hardware class. It offers significant resource density, reducing the need for multi-node cluster orchestration for large-scale tasks. The hardware profile is engineered for intensive workloads such as large language model training, complex deep learning tasks, high-performance data science jobs, and massive parallel database operations.
